title.narrative: Provision of integrated lifesaving emergency health care services in Qansaxdhera district in Bay region of SWS Somalia

description.narrative:
ltp class="" style="text-align: justify"gtltfont style="" color="#000000" face="Arial, sans-serif"gtThe main objective of this project is to provide integrated life-saving emergency primary health services to drought affected direct beneficiaries (women , girls, boys ,men ) through continuous of three health facilities and 3 mobile/outreach team (covering 16 villages/ IDP locations). The project which will run for 12 Months, will support 25,000 individuals including 15% men, 25%omen, 30% Boys and 30% Girls. This call for proposal is for the continuation of existing health services currently supported through MARDO’s other funding after previous SHF project duration and funding has come to an end in March 2023. The proposed project will expand services in rural areas and hard-to-reach areas in order to minimize further displacement and increase access to essential health services to affected women, girls, and boys including minority/marginalized groups within the catchment areas. lt/fontgtltspan style="text-align: justify"gtltfont color="#000000" face="Arial, sans-serif"gtThe proposed integrated health lt/fontgtltfont color="#000000" face="Arial, sans-serif"gtresponse will therefore complement and build on MARDO’s ongoing humanitarian and long-term programs in addressing the emerging needs of women, girls lt/fontgtltfont color="#000000" face="Arial, sans-serif"gtand reach additional beneficiaries. Beneficiaries targeted under the proposed intervention will also benefit from WASH hygiene kits and nutrition services to children/mothers who are malnourished or with severely malnourished children. MARDO is able to roll out the activities within a short time for effective response soonest the grant is awarded and documentation is finalized with UNOCHA. MARDO has active PCA and agreement with UNICEF/MOH which will provide prompt and continuous availability of health supplies which will complement the project resources. MARDO has the advantage of long term relationship with local Authorities and community while building on its current strategy of providing a comprehensive package of humanitarian support in its areas of operation which will sustain and provide humanitarian support beyond the proposed response period.lt/fontgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="" style=""gtltspan style="line-height: 107% font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black"gt Health: Emphasis will be on maternal, neonatal and child health including emergency immunization to the host communities and IDPs (including girls ,women ) as well as treatment of common illness, sexual reproductive health services (ANC/PNC skilled delivery, GBV ), building the capacity of health workers through training on MHPSS, integrated management of acute illness IMCI, Cholera/measles case management and community case management CCM will be done to equip health workers with the required skills to deliver quality healthcare services. Affected women will be counseled on the importance of delivering at a health facility or with a skilled birth attendant, family planning methods, and exclusive breastfeeding. In addition, particular focus will be given to ensuring the participation of people with special needs or with disabilities by targeting 10% of the total target population. MARDO as regional cold chain manager for immunization in South west state, will employ strategies to increase immunization coverage by promoting synergy between health interventions, accelerate immunization program and social mobilization and awareness raising.lt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="" style=""gtltspan style="line-height: 107% font-family: Arial, sans-serif color:
